(2) As she continues her explanation, she becomes more animated, using her right hand to gesture emphatically. She holds up one finger to emphasize a specific point about accounting practices. The background remains a consistent high-rise office setting. (3) She momentarily lifts a stack of white papers from below the frame to indicate a ledger or document. Her eyes squint slightly as she explains a complex financial concept. (4) She uses both hands to gesture outward, explaining the relationship between majority and minority shareholders. visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 葳老板的辣雞湯. [Subtitle]: 你是25%的股東. (2) [Subtitle]: 就可以得到25%的盈餘嗎? (3) [Subtitle]: 我知道大家一定都會這樣想. (4) [Subtitle]: 但是不一定哦. (5) [Subtitle]: 因為要看這十年的帳是怎麼做的. (6) [Subtitle]: 很多中小企業為了節稅. (7) [Subtitle]: 通常會把帳做成好像打平. (8) [Subtitle]: 是不是就沒有盈餘了. (9) [Subtitle]: 那就算你是股東你也分配不到盈餘. (10) [Subtitle]: 因為帳上面看起來就是沒有盈餘啊. [Variety]: (天~~). (11) [Subtitle]: 如果她是做成打平沒有盈餘. (12) [Subtitle]: 那公司就是沒有賺錢. (13) [Subtitle]: 那你身為25%的股東也分不到錢. (14) [Subtitle]: 但是就算公司帳上有賺錢你可能還是拿不到哦. [Variety]: 為什麼? 為什麼? (15) [Subtitle]: 因為你是25%的小股東嘛. (16) [Subtitle]: 那真正有決定權的是那75%的大股東們. (17) [Subtitle]: 如果大股東決定這個帳上盈餘我們不分配, 你還是分不到. (18) [Subtitle]: 只要公司的大股東們決定不打算分配盈餘, 你還是拿不到. (19) [Subtitle]: 那這一點要如何破解? (20) [Subtitle]: 建議剛開始在合夥的時候, 在你們的股東協議或公司章程裡面就要寫好. (21) [Subtitle]: 我們只要盈餘有超過100萬的情況下, 那我們最少就是要分50%. (22) [Subtitle]: 那你是每年就要拿50萬出來分. (23) [Subtitle]: 可是如果你沒有明定這一條, 公司股東是可以決定永遠不分配盈餘.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate small investors or business partners on the legal and accounting complexities of shareholding. It specifically warns that owning 25% of shares does not automatically guarantee a 25% profit payout if the majority shareholders or the accounting methods prevent it. It advocates for clear clauses in shareholder agreements.
